build_transcriber: build a Transcriber instance from a model name or asset card for speech-to-text transcription
run_inference_transcribe: run inference to transcribe audio from a file path or tensor into text with word-level timestamps
load_tokenizer: load a tokenizer (SPMTokenizer or NllbTokenizer) from a model asset card by tokenizer type
load_model_for_inference: load a Unity model for inference by name or card and set it to eval mode
denoise_audio: denoise audio input using Demucs and return the decoded waveform with sample rate
